cases.name: a child machine invoked in a nested state answers the entry's ping and the parent finishes
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > with machines > should create invocations from machines in nested states

cases.name: a host actor receives the invoke's static input and its output finishes the machine
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > invoke `src` can be used with invoke `input`

cases.name: an invoke without an id is named after its index and state, and its done event carries that name
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > invoke generated ID should be predictable based on the state node where it is defined

cases.name: an invoke of a machine given in place registers a child under its generated id
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > invoke config defined as src containing a machine directly should register unique and predictable child in state (the children are read after start, which the format always runs first)

cases.name: the done of one of two invokes of the same src selects only its own state's onDone
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > xstate.done.actor events should only select onDone transition on the invoking state when invokee is referenced using a string

cases.name: two invokes of one machine report their done under their own invoke ids
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > xstate.done.actor events should have unique names when invokee is a machine with an id property

cases.name: a delayed event the invoking state's entry sends reaches the invoked child, whose answer finishes the parent
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > should be able to receive a delayed event sent by the entry action of the invoking state (the child answers with sendParent: the origin the PING carried is the parent itself, an actor reference the event cannot hold)

cases.name: a host actor receives the invoke's input computed from the context and its output finishes the machine
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > invoke `src` can be used with dynamic invoke `input` (the expect on input.endpoint is the pending request's input; the completion is the status after the resolve)

cases.name: a root reentering transition stops the root's pending invoke and starts it again
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > root invocations should restart on root reentering transitions (the count of the promise's starts is the two host actors created at root/0.root: the first stopped by EVENT while its request is pending, its later answer refused, and the second, root/0.root#2, pending after EVENT)

cases.name: a host actor receives an input of a fixed member and one computed from the context
cases.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke input > should provide input to an actor creator (the expect on the input is the pending request's input; the completion is the status after the resolve)

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > with machines > should emit onSnapshot
excluded.reason: onSnapshot is not ported to the actor layer (the actor layer leaves syncSnapshot out; xstate's README lists syncSnapshot and onSnapshot under 'Not yet'): actor_system never sends a parent the xstate.snapshot.<id> event, so XState's record would hold snapshot events xstate cannot produce. The action itself is now expressible (a compare guard on {"$event": "snapshot.value"} == "b" and a push); what it still needs is the actor layer relaying a child's snapshots to a parent whose invoke has onSnapshot

excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the two callbacks reach the parent through sendBack

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > multiple simultaneous services > should run services in parallel
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the two callbacks reach the parent through sendBack

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > multiple simultaneous services > should not invoke an actor if it gets stopped immediately by transitioning away in subsequent microstep
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the callback only records that it started, and the test asserts that it never did

excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the callback, which does nothing, is the service that the raised STOP_ONE stops in the macrostep that invokes the promise

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > multiple simultaneous services > should invoke an actor when reentering invoking state within a single macrostep
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the callback only counts its starts, and the test asserts that it started once

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > invoke config defined as src with string reference should register unique and predictable child in state
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): someSrc is a callback that does nothing, and the test reads the child 0.machine.a in the snapshot of an actor it never starts

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > invoke config defined as src containing a callback actor directly should register unique and predictable child in state
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the src is a callback given in place that does nothing, and the test reads the child 0.machine.a in the snapshot of an actor it never starts

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > should get reinstantiated after reentering the invoking state in a microstep
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the callback only counts its starts, and the test asserts that it started twice

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > invocations should be stopped when the machine reaches done state
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the test spies on the disposal function the root's invoked callback returns

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > deep invocations should be stopped when the machine reaches done state
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the test spies on the disposal function returned by the callback that the invoked child machine invokes

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke > should be able to restart an invoke when reentering the invoking state
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer): the callback logs its start and its stop, and the test asserts the exact order ['stop 1', 'start 2'], an order between two actors that the record does not hold

excluded.test: invoke.test.ts > invoke input > should provide self to input mapper
excluded.reason: self as data: the input mapper passes the parent's actor reference, which JSON cannot hold; and fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer)
